rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone or something of high status, honor, or nobility.

example.english: This exalted guest will present the awards to us tonight.
example.traditional: 呢位尊貴嘅嘉賓今晚會為我哋頒獎。
example.jyutping: ne1 wai6 zyun1 gwai3 ge3 gaa1 ban1 gam1 maan1 wui5 wai6 ngo5 dei6 baan1 zoeng2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is specifically on being honored or respected by other people.

example.english: They have been a teacher for decades and are highly exalted in the community.
example.traditional: 佢做咗幾十年老師，一直都好受人尊敬。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4 lou5 si1 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 sau6 jan4 zyun1 ging3

rows.note: Use this for lofty, sublime, or morally noble ideals and qualities rather than ordinary social status.

example.english: Pursuing justice is an exalted ideal.
example.traditional: 追求公義係一種崇高嘅理想。
example.jyutping: zeoi1 kau4 gung1 ji6 hai6 jat1 zung2 sung4 gou1 ge3 lei5 soeng2
